# Output files

<img class="figure" src="/images/outputs.webp" alt="Where reports land: reviews, then the fund, then the date, then the run ID, then reports, analysis, drafts, compliance, tracking, analytics and portfolio folders" />

Each skill writes a fixed filename family, so downstream skills (`report-pdf`, `counsel-handoff`, `search-precedent`, `vault-sync`) can find earlier results. Saved reports follow shared contract v1 under the approved output root (never beside inputs or in the working-directory root):

```text
reviews/
└── <fund>/
    └── <date>/
        └── <run-id>/
            ├── run.json
            └── <subfolder>/
                └── <report-id>/
                    ├── <filename>
                    └── <filename>.json
```

Common `<subfolder>` names and filename families:

| Folder | Filename families |
|---|---|
| `reports/` | `LPA-REVIEW-…`, `COUNSEL-HANDOFF-…`, `PPM-REVIEW-…`, `SUBSCRIPTION-REVIEW-…`, `SIDE-LETTER-REVIEW-…`, `CAPITAL-CALL-REVIEW-…`, `DISTRIBUTION-REVIEW-…`, `CAPITAL-ACCOUNT-REVIEW-…`, `K1-REVIEW-…`, `POA-REVIEW-…`, `GP-UPDATE-REVIEW-…`, `DEED-REVIEW-…`, `FUND-REVIEW-REPORT.pdf` |
| `analysis/` | `BENCHMARK-REPORT-…`, `WATERFALL-REVIEW-…`, `TERMS-EXTRACT-…`, `PLAIN-ENGLISH-…`, `FUND-COMPARISON-…`, `MULTI-DOC-ANALYSIS-…`, `TERMS-PLAYBOOK-…`, `PRECEDENT-SEARCH-…` |
| `drafts/` | `CAPITAL-CALL-…`, `DISTRIBUTION-NOTICE-…`, `INVESTOR-LETTER-…`, `SIDE-LETTER-…`, `AMENDMENT-DRAFT-…` |
| `compliance/` | `COMPLIANCE-REVIEW-…`, `KYC-REVIEW-…`, `FILING-PREP-…`, `REGULATORY-CALENDAR-…` |
| `tracking/` | `MFN-TRACKER-…`, `OBLIGATION-TRACKER-…`, `COVENANT-MONITOR-…` |
| `analytics/` | `PERFORMANCE-REPORT-…`, `CASHFLOW-FORECAST-…`, `SCENARIO-MODEL-…`, `FEE-AUDIT-…` |
| `portfolio/` | `PORTFOLIO-DASHBOARD-…`, `RECONCILIATION-…` |

`report-pdf` writes `FUND-REVIEW-REPORT.pdf` into the same isolated run. Child skills share the parent's run ID and use distinct report IDs; existing reports are preserved. Every command's page in this manual names its file, and [`catalog.json`](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/catalog.json) lists them for machines.

Placeholders in filenames are always `[fund]`, `[investor]`, `[type]` and `[date]`; `[fund]` is a slug of the fund name and `[date]` is the review date. Use `fund_report.py new-run` and `write-report` for validated Markdown plus an evidence sidecar.
